text.title: Blue tang
text.nearby: A royal blue tang with a yellow tail swims by the coral.
text.about_looks: A flat round fish. Its body is royal blue with a black mark across it. Its tail and belly are bright yellow.
text.about_food: Mostly marine algae. It scrapes and nibbles algae from rock and coral. It also sips tiny plankton as it swims.
text.about_home: Lives on the reef near branching coral. At night it rests in coral heads and small cracks.
text.about_winter: Stays active all year. It swims and eats through every season.
text.about_young: Babies are born from tiny floating eggs. They drift in the water, then settle on the reef as little yellow fish.
text.about_fact: It scrapes algae from the reef with small teeth.
text.menu_sub: Swim the warm reef in a bright blue group and graze algae off the coral.
text.menu_wild: Bigger fish hunt on the reef.
text.hungry: You're hungry. Look for algae growing on the coral and rocks.
text.no_food: Nothing to eat here. Look for algae on the coral and rocks.

year.young: Young are born from tiny floating eggs. They drift as larvae and then settle on the reef as small yellow fish.

food.spring: Marine algae and filamentous algae from rock and coral, and a little zooplankton.
